en.question: If <<6039>>'s effect is applying and <<5025>> is destroyed by battle and returned to the Deck as a result, can its effect be activated?
en.title: If <<6039>>'s effect is applying and <<5025>> is destroyed by battle, can its effect be activated?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<5025>>」の効果は発動します。
